design_authority: docs/us_short_system_design.md §4.2 (分析师修正) / §5.2 (分析师集体下调 candidate veto) / §3.1 (provenance) / §3.5 (PIT: 评级动作日与 as_of 是不同事实; 不用 look-ahead) / §18.2 (跨模块契约先 schema-first 冻结再消费)
authorization_note: OFFLINE contract SHAPE only. Live FMP fetch + runner wiring stay gated under SR-PROVIDER-001. Reachability + real shape were proven 2026-07-01 (docs/us_short_cut5_pass2_feasibility_probe_summary_20260701.json + captured gitignored raw): FMP stable /grades returns a LIST of {symbol, date, gradingCompany, newGrade, previousGrade, action} analyst rating-change records; the observed `action` values are {upgrade, downgrade, maintain}. FMP CLASSIFIES the action directly, so this binding uses `action` and needs NO grade-string ranking. This is the FREE proxy for the (paywalled, user-deferred 2026-07-01) numeric analyst-estimate revisions.
recency_window_basis: calendar days before as_of. §4.2/§5.2 recent-analyst-sentiment prior — a REVIEWED calibration prior, NOT validated alpha (FMP grades go back to 2012; only recent actions bear on current sentiment). Change = reviewed schema + binding version bump.
direction_note: FMP's own `action` field drives direction: upgrade -> up, downgrade -> down, ANY OTHER action (maintain / initiate / reiterate / unknown) -> neutral. No analyst grade-string ranking (scales differ: Buy / Overweight / Outperform / Neutral / Equal Weight / Market Perform / ...); a non-upgrade/downgrade action can NEVER fabricate a direction. The raw `action` string is carried verbatim in each fact.

summary_contract.over: the recent-window (<= recency_window_days) fit records only
summary_contract.note: the §4.2 analyst-revision-DIRECTION signal + the §5.2 collective-downgrade basis (distinct_downgrading_firms = distinct gradingCompany with at least one downgrade in the window; neutral/up firms do not create the collective-downgrade signal).

pit_rule: each record `date` must be a real YYYY-MM-DD <= as_of; a future-dated record is EXCLUDED (look-ahead, §3.5); a record older than recency_window_days is OUT-OF-WINDOW (counted, not in the summary/records). A malformed (bad-shape) date fails closed (raise). If a record carries `symbol`, canonical(symbol) must equal the ticker key (no mis-attribution).

emission_fitness.note: only a full-coverage clean-parse ticker emits an analyst-grades signal; partial / missing / failed / degraded -> excluded (conservative). A full/ok ticker with ZERO in-window records emits NO signal (no recent analyst activity = neutral; the consumer defaults neutral per §4.2 缺分量中性).

date_format: as_of / record date = YYYY-MM-DD (ASCII, real-calendar); observed_at = tz-aware RFC3339 date-time
consumer_note: Produces the §4.2 分析师修正 direction signal + §5.2 collective-downgrade basis as a FACT+summary layer. The SCORE wiring (feed the catalyst analyst component / a §5.2 candidate-veto accumulator) is a LATER seam. This slice freezes the fact contract + parses/validates it; it does NOT score.

duplicate_policy.note: a grade action's identity; grading_company is normalized (whitespace-collapsed + casefold) so ` bankx `/`BankX`/`BANKX` are ONE firm — a repeated identity fails closed (never inflating net or distinct_firms). record_date is a day-only grade date bound to the observation date (a same-day action is in-window only if provably observed pre-open).

checked_empty_note: a full-coverage clean-parse ticker with ZERO in-window grade records emits a CHECKED coverage record (disposition checked_no_recent_activity) retaining its provenance — DISTINCT from a never-queried ticker (§3.3, must not collapse checked to unknown). Downstream defaults neutral either way, but the audit distinction is retained.
